style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright cheerful colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of the inside of a big bright natural history museum hall like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO skeletons, NO dinosaurs, NO animals and NO people: a pale warm wall with tall arched windows showing blue sky, a high ceiling with wooden beams, a few framed pictures of plants and leaves, a potted plant at each side, and a wide empty polished wooden floor across the bottom third of the picture.
